user.title: Connect Parcel
user.description:
Parcel's API comes with Parcel Premium. To get your key:

1. Sign in at [web.parcelapp.net]({web_url}).
2. Select **API** (next to My Deliveries and Add Delivery).
3. Select **Create a Key**, then **Copy the Key**, and paste it below.

Each Parcel account has one key. If you revoke it later, Home Assistant will ask for the new one. [More help]({docs_url})

data_description.api_key: The key from the Parcel API panel in the web app.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter your new Parcel API key
reauth_confirm.description: Parcel no longer accepts the API key for **{title}**, usually because it was revoked. Sign in at [web.parcelapp.net]({web_url}), select **API**, then **Create a Key** and **Copy the Key**. [More help]({docs_url})

error.invalid_auth: Parcel didn't accept this API key. Check it, or create a new one in the Parcel web app.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Parcel. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Parcel's limit of 20 checks an hour was reached. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: Something unexpected happened. The logs have details.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already set up.

init.title: Parcel options
init.description: **Deleting packages:** Parcel's API can't delete, so Home Assistant uses your Parcel web sign-in for that. Sign in at [web.parcelapp.net]({web_url}), copy the `account_token` cookie from your browser's developer tools, and paste it below. It lasts about a year. [Step-by-step help]({docs_url})

data.package_sensors: Create a sensor for each package

data_description.scan_interval: Parcel allows 20 checks an hour, so 4 minutes is the shortest.
data_description.package_sensors: Each package gets its own sensor, removed two days after delivery. The summary sensors are always there.
data_description.account_token: Optional. Paste a new one to turn deleting on, or to replace the one you saved. A saved sign-in is never shown here, so leave this empty to keep it.
data_description.remove_account_token: Turns deleting off until you paste a sign-in again.

error.invalid_account_token: Parcel didn't accept this sign-in. Sign in again at web.parcelapp.net and copy the new account_token.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Parcel. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Parcel asked Home Assistant to slow down. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: Something unexpected happened. The logs have details.
error.account_token_other_account: This sign-in is for a different Parcel account: none of this account's packages on their way are in it. Sign in at web.parcelapp.net with the account this API key belongs to, and copy its account_token.

trigger_type.package_out_for_delivery: A package is out for delivery
trigger_type.package_ready_for_pickup: A package is ready for pickup

add_package.name: Add package
add_package.description: Starts tracking a package in Parcel. Parcel allows 20 adds a day, failed tries included.

config_entry_id.name: Parcel account
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one account is set up.

tracking_number.name: Tracking number
tracking_number.description: The number from the shipping email or receipt.

description.name: Name
description.description: What to call the package, shown here and in the Parcel app.

carrier.name: Carrier code
carrier.description: Parcel's code for the carrier, like ups or usps. Leave empty to recognize it from the number.

postcode.name: Postcode
postcode.description: Only for carriers that need it.

email.name: Email
email.description: Only for carriers that need it, such as Apple Store orders.

send_push_confirmation.name: Confirm on phone
send_push_confirmation.description: Have Parcel send a notification to your devices when the package is added.

delete_package.name: Delete package
delete_package.description: Deletes a package from Parcel on all your devices. Needs the Parcel web sign-in in the integration's options.

config_entry_id.name: Parcel account
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one account is set up.

carrier.name: Carrier code
carrier.description: Only needed if two packages share a tracking number.

refresh.name: Check for updates
refresh.description: Checks Parcel now. Parcel allows 20 checks an hour.

config_entry_id.name: Parcel account
config_entry_id.description: Leave empty to check every account.

hourly_limit.message: Parcel's limit of 20 checks an hour has been reached. Home Assistant will check again in about {minutes} minutes.

invalid_api_key.message: Parcel didn't accept the API key. If you revoked it, enter the new key.

rate_limited.message: Parcel asked Home Assistant to slow down. It will check again in about {minutes} minutes.

refresh_limit.message: Parcel allows 20 checks an hour, and a few are kept for scheduled checks. Try again in about {minutes} minutes.

rate_limit_pause.message: Parcel asked Home Assistant to slow down, so checks are paused for about {minutes} more minutes.

description_required.message: Enter a name for the package.

carrier_required.message: Couldn't tell the carrier from this number. Choose the carrier.

unknown_carrier.message: Parcel doesn't know the carrier code "{carrier}".

extra_required.message: {carrier} needs one more detail to track this package.

add_limit.message: Parcel allows 20 new packages a day through Home Assistant, and today's are used up. Try again tomorrow, or add it in the Parcel app.

delete_needs_sign_in.message: To delete packages, add your Parcel web sign-in in the integration's options.

web_sign_in_expired.message: Your Parcel web sign-in has expired. Sign in again at web.parcelapp.net and update it in the integration's options.

delete_ambiguous.message: Nothing was deleted. Parcel lists this number in a way that doesn't say which package it is, as with an Amazon order shipped in parts. Delete it in the Parcel app.

delete_not_confirmed.message: Parcel said the package was deleted, but it's still listed. Try again, or delete it in the Parcel app.

choose_account.message: More than one Parcel account is set up. Choose which one to use.

choose_carrier.message: More than one package has this tracking number. Add the carrier code.

web_sign_in_other_account.message: Nothing was deleted. The saved web sign-in doesn't list this account's packages, so it may be for a different Parcel account. Paste the right one in the integration's options.

delete_not_added_yet.message: Parcel hasn't finished adding this package yet, so there's nothing to delete. Try again in a minute.

web_sign_in_expired.title: Parcel web sign-in expired
web_sign_in_expired.description: Parcel no longer accepts the web sign-in for **{title}**, so Home Assistant can't delete packages from it. Sign in again at web.parcelapp.net, copy the new `account_token` cookie, and paste it in **Settings › Devices & services › Parcel › Configure**.

web_sign_in_expiring.title: Parcel web sign-in expires soon
web_sign_in_expiring.description: The Parcel web sign-in for **{title}** expires in about {days} days. Deleting packages keeps working until then. When you have a minute, sign in at web.parcelapp.net, copy the new `account_token` cookie, and paste it in **Settings › Devices & services › Parcel › Configure**.
